claims.statement_en: A community-shared list gives 32 of the 34 village names (unverified, single source)

sources.notes: This is the first full-ish list of the 34 found anywhere. It is community memory, not an official record: cross-check each name against the 1981 census handbook / acquisition notifications. Names absent from our earlier registry: 21 new; names in our registry but absent from the list: Chidasar, Meusar (probably = मेहुसर), Kolana (probably = कनलाई?), Ajeetwana, Bhanabasti, Nathor. Kolana vs Kanolai: the list has only कनलाई, supporting the earlier guess that they are one village.
